```python
def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    n = len(source)
    while i < n:
        c = source[i]
        if c in ' \t\n\r':
            i += 1
        elif c == ';':
            while i < n and source[i] != '\n':
                i += 1
        elif c in '()':
            tokens.append(c)
            i += 1
        elif c == "'":
            tokens.append("'")
            i += 1
        elif c == '"':
            # read string
            i += 1
            chars = []
            while i < n:
                if source[i] == '"':
                    i += 1
                    break
                elif source[i] == '\\':
                    i += 1
                    if i >= n:
                        raise SyntaxError("unterminated string")
                    if source[i] == '"': chars.append('"')
                    elif source[i] == '\\': chars.append('\\')
                    elif source[i] == 'n': chars.append('\n')
                    else: raise SyntaxError(f"bad escape \\{source[i]}")
                    i += 1
                else:
                    chars.append(source[i])
                    i += 1
            else:
                raise SyntaxError("unterminated string")
            tokens.append(('string', ''.join(chars)))
        else:
            # regular token
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] not in ' \t\n\r()";\'':
                j += 1
            tokens.append(('atom', source[i:j]))
            i = j
    return tokens
```
